unplaced.detail: Verses attributed to Bhaviṣya have no secure position in the received Brāhma-parvan.
Additional attributed verses were reported without a chapter by chapter alignment.

The quoted verses beginning bheryāṇi ca vādyāni and vimānam iti, and three lines beginning dhana-dhānyam, have no located match in the received text. Other passages are placed by chapter above, though their individual folios remain unresolved.
The Bhaviṣya is described through the saptamī-kalpa; the aṣṭamī and navamī sections of that witness are not present in this received form.
